captions.linkedin:
Most people tailor their first few applications and then fall back to sending the same file everywhere. It's understandable: tailoring by hand takes time.

But every job description asks for a different mix of skills, and one resume can only match some of them.

With QuickFit CV you upload your resume once. It becomes your profile. Then for each job you paste the description and get a version that leads with what that job asks for, built only from your real experience.

Free to try: https://quickfitcv.com

#jobsearch #resume #careers
